title: Quadratic pair matrix tester
statement: For each $n\ge 0$, consider a tester on addresses that are either vectors in $\mathbb F_2^n$ or $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb F_2$. It samples two independent uniform binary vectors of length $n^2$, queries the matrices obtained by reshaping each vector and their sum, and makes no fourth query. It accepts exactly when the first two returned values sum to the third in $\mathbb F_2$; any missing answer causes rejection.
